subject: Maria finished in 9 days
preview_text: A story that might feel familiar: Maria, tight deadline, zero clarity, finished her thesis in 9 days.
body_paragraphs: {{first_name}}, remember that feeling when the deadline is breathing down your neck and your outline is still a chaotic mess? That was Maria two months ago — a master's student staring down a climate policy thesis with no clear path forward and just over a week to deliver.

Maria had already used Thesis Generator once before, but this time she was stuck in a loop of overthinking. She fed the app her scattered notes, and within minutes it gave her a coherent structure that broke her topic into manageable sections. She wrote one section each day, leaned on the generator to sharpen her arguments, and submitted her draft on day nine — no all-nighters, no panic.

What Maria learned is that finishing fast isn't about working harder; it's about working with a tool that already knows how you think. You've got the same app, the same edge — your {{topic}} doesn't need to be a marathon.
P.S. If your {{work_type}} feels stuck, try opening Thesis Generator and typing just the first sentence that comes to mind. Maria started with 'Climate policy is a mess' and it worked.
